verdict.rationale: ADK has documented built-in evaluation features (test files representing agent-model interactions, two methods to evaluate against predefined datasets/criteria) plus a dev UI to test/evaluate agents, but there's no explicit evidence of CI integration (e.g., CLI eval command for pipelines, exit codes, CI examples/docs). Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD integration documentation, evidence of a CLI eval runner suitable for automated pipelines, and independent confirmation of CI usage.
